name: Junxun
source:
On September 1, the sweltering summer has yet to end. Freshmen entering high school across China take part in compulsory military training before they even begin attending classes. Under strict discipline, in a high school life where even romance is forbidden, you feel that something is being slowly taken away. Before long, you start planning a rebellion.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2838540/Dying_in_the_Sun]Steam[/url]]
translation:
9月1日，酷暑尚未消散。踏入中国各地高中的高一新生们，在正式上课之前都必须先参加强制性的新生军训。在严苛的纪律管束之下、在连恋爱都惨遭禁止的高中生活里，你感到有什么东西正在被一点点夺走。没过多久，你便开始暗中筹划一场反叛。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2838540/Dying_in_the_Sun]Steam[/url]]
